mx_handoff: The app resolves provider pages first and decodes the DW transport envelope before MX. MX receives only the final HTTP(S) media URL plus request headers.
playback_extractor_rule: For episodes/movies, mov/webm/embed are resolved before player handoff; m3u8 is direct only when its URL path is an actual .m3u8; mp4/mkv/mpd are direct. The API external flag no longer causes an internal provider page to be sent straight to MX.
quality_selection: When the original extractor returns multiple R0/a streams, the app shows their original quality names and resolves/validates the selected URL before MX handoff.
server_labels: Restored original Drama World quick-play, multi-quality, HD and download labels.
guest_access_rule: The supplied Drama World V4.2f guest path was verified in raw DEX: EpisodesActivity.g1, MovieActivity.F1 and ChannelActivity.L0 return true on both branches. The integration therefore does not invent a local account block from playas/downloadas/premium values; any real remote authentication requirement is still enforced by the source itself.
download_rule: Download rows follow the returned both/download kinds and omit youtube/embed as the original episode download callback does. Non-direct media/provider pages are resolved before downloader handoff instead of being treated as final URLs solely because of external=false.
known_limitations: Some providers are already unavailable in the original Drama World app, and providers that depend on protected remote extractor configuration can still fail. This build corrects the premature MX handoff and the false local account gate; live providers still require real-phone verification.
